title: Joint Dynamic Lane Reversal and Variable Speed Limit Control: A Graphormer-Based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.35070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Connected and automated vehicles could allow reassigning lane directions and speed limits on every road frequently, but the benefit hinges on how traffic reroutes, and one-way roads can isolate junctions. We formulate network-wide dynamic lane allocation and directional speed limit control with one-way roads, lane clearing before each reversal, and a navigable graph kept strongly connected at all times. An action-resolution algorithm grounded in graph orientation theory admits a proposal closing a direction only if the network stays strongly connected and otherwise relaxes or reverts it, keeping all junctions mutually reachable within the model, even during clearing. translated_title: 基于Graphormer的车道动态可逆与可变限速联合控制方法
translated_abstract: 网联自动驾驶车辆使得每条道路上的车道方向和限速能够频繁重新分配，但其收益取决于交通流如何重新路由，而且单向道路可能导致交叉口之间被隔离。本文对全网范围内的动态车道分配与方向性限速控制问题进行了形式化建模，其中考虑了单向道路、每次换向前的车道清空过程，以及始终保持强连通的可导航路网图。一种基于图定向理论提出的动作解析算法规定，只有在网络保持强连通的前提下才允许关闭某个方向，否则会对该动作进行放松或撤销，从而即使在车道清空期间也能保证模型中所有交叉口相互可达。所有道路控制器共享同一个Transformer，其注意力机制——全局端点关系感知时空自注意力（GERASTSA）——覆盖所有道路-时间token，并由道路之间的端点关系进行偏置。该模型在动作条件下的交通预测任务上进行预训练……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Graphormer的车道动态可逆与可变限速联合控制方法，利用基于图定向理论的动作解析算法保证路网在换向清空过程中始终保持强连通，并通过带全局端点关系感知时空自注意力（GERASTSA）的共享Transformer实现全网协调控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Graphormer-based joint dynamic lane reversal and variable speed limit control approach, which guarantees network strong connectivity during lane clearing via a graph-orientation-theory-grounded action-resolution algorithm, and coordinates all road controllers through a shared transformer with Global Endpoint Relation-Aware Spatio-Temporal Self-Attention (GERASTSA).
